definitions.explanation: The arteries that wrap around the heart and supply it with blood. When one becomes blocked, the result can be a heart attack ({心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}).

examples.japanese: {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
{冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had my coronary arteries examined.

examples.japanese: {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}く→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かなく→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When the coronary arteries narrow, the heart can no longer receive enough blood.

notes:
The arteries surrounding the heart that supply it with blood; a blockage can cause a heart attack.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: a coronary artery becomes blocked
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}⟦{疾患|しっかん}→疾患：16370_shikkan⟧: coronary artery disease
- {冠動脈|かんどうみゃく}バイパス⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: coronary bypass surgery
